purpose: Proposed Aureveil social launch page previews for the presentation. Actual social accounts have not been created.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-resolution social-media page launch mockup for a presentation, not a real account screenshot.
Brand reference images: preserve Aureveil product identity (ivory tube, navy serif aureveil, pale blue cap, thin gold line), photo palette and premium visual tone. These are supporting visual references, not UI edit targets.
Brand styling: ivory, pastel blue, navy and warm gold; spacious editorial typography.
Profile name exact: "Aureveil". Proposed handle exact: "@aureveil.skin".
Footer label exact and clearly legible: "Proposed launch preview".
No invented follower counts, likes, views, testimonials, verified badge or engagement numbers. Hide counts entirely rather than adding numbers. No real profile URL, no claim that this account exists. No extra brand names. No seven-day transformations, age reversal, once-a-day sunscreen or reef-safe claim. Product copy may say "Daily Sun Serum" and "Cloud Mist". Keep text sparse, crisp and accurately spelled.
Create one portrait-oriented 4:5 Instagram brand profile UI mockup on a clean ivory canvas, straight-on screen view with no phone hardware. Recognisable Instagram interface: top profile navigation, circular "a" wordmark avatar, brand name/handle, concise bio and grid tabs. Bio exact: "Daily SPF. A little more care." Add exact website label "Explore Aureveil" without URL.
A polished six-post grid, two rows of three, fills the lower majority. Alternate product photography matching the references, a woman applying sunscreen, and clean pastel editorial cards.
Six tile titles, each short and legible: "Fine lines? Dark spots?", "Meet your daily SPF", "Skincare. SPF. Makeup.", "SPF50, explained", "A little hydration reset", "Try the texture first".
Use the referenced product photography creatively in the tiles; no original third-party packaging. Clear official-looking but proposed Instagram account layout; not a floating ad poster.
assets.refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target Image1: proposed Aureveil Instagram mockup. Supporting product insert Image2: the correct Aureveil Cloud Mist bottle.
Change only the post grid, preserve the whole Instagram header, profile name, proposed handle, bio, button, tabs, ivory/pastel-blue/gold/navy styling and "Proposed launch preview" footer exactly.
The grid must contain EXACTLY SIX equally-sized square posts, arranged in TWO ROWS of THREE. No extra split cells or seventh tile. Each post is one complete self-contained card with its own title.
Row1 column1: pastel editorial card with exact title "Fine lines? Dark spots?".
Row1 column2: Aureveil sunscreen tube photograph with exact short title "Meet your daily SPF" integrated on that same card.
Row1 column3: woman applying sunscreen with exact title "Skincare. SPF. Makeup.".
Row2 column1: pastel educational card with exact title "SPF50, explained".
Row2 column2: use the correct Cloud Mist bottle from Image2, with exact title "A little hydration reset".
Row2 column3: elegant sunscreen texture swatch with exact title "Try the texture first".
Do not turn the separate product photo into an extra post. Preserve readable exact brand spelling. Do not add follower/like/view counts or real account claims.
assets.visualQA: Exactly six post tiles in two rows of three; Cloud Mist bottle corrected; clear Proposed launch preview footer; no follower or engagement counts.
